task_definition.task_description: Please reserve 1 black Sony XM5 for me, then create the checkout from that hold. After that, scan my living room devices, pick the smart light, check its current status, prepare a 70% brightness setting, and turn it on to warm white at 70%. Then get the living room smart lock access record and archive it as a high-priority “Pickup Area Access Record” in the app, submit the headphone order using the best discount with PayPal, and finally send me a high-priority app alert once it’s confirmed.

user_input.query: Please reserve 1 black Sony XM5 for me using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk and quantity 1, and create the checkout from that hold. Use my user_id user_123, and note the items array includes this exact item: product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. Then scan the devices in my living_room area, find the smart_light target_device_type, select device_id light_living, check its current status, prepare brightness 70, and turn it on to warm white at 70%. After that, get the smart lock access record for living_room and archive it in the app as a high-priority record titled “Pickup Area Access Record.” Finally, submit the headphone order with the best discount using paypal as the payment_method, and once it’s confirmed, send me a high-priority app alert through the app channel.
